cuda: untested on CUDA; checked on CPU fixtures only

family_78b.engine_rule: PP4 (the lead's ruling, 5 Nov 2026): every wrapper kind runs on engine X (engine_x above): untuned_answers, rep_pass, l1_scan and classifier on the pod; l1_score, s3_score, score_edit, add_edit and s_pool on the Mac. Every derived settings file carries engine_x unchanged from the 1B file, and the frozen check_settings refuses another engine identity (R: scripts/stage1/s1common.py:589-591). A run on engine Y needs the settings re-derived for Y (engine_x = Y's identity, a new PINS-78B.json, a new PINS_FILE_SHA256) by a recorded step; none exists. The engine's own jobs (the a0-1101 retrain, a1_pass) follow ruling 10 and addendum A13, not this rule. The kit packs scorer pods with engine X.
family_78b.rule: the 1B file's schema and name, so scripts/stage1's unchanged check_settings accepts it; every value that differs from the 1B file is per family (pins_78b.json) or a documented 7-8B rule; a null is a pin that waits for the event named in waits; scorers_78b.py refuses a command while a pin it needs is null

pins.anchor_bank_sha256.event: the OLMo-2-7B anchor job (scripts/make_anchor_answers.py on the family's main recipe, single-job pod, KD6): anchors.sealed.json 'anchor_file_sha256' of its committed record

pins.recipe_sha256.event: the OLMo-2-7B anchor job, then scripts/scale78b/make_recipe_s78.py --family olmo2-7b --anchors-sha256 <anchor_file_sha256>, then the lead's commit by explicit path (addendum A1, A2); the same value as runkit/stage1-78b/rules_78b.py RECIPE_S['olmo2-7b']

name: score_classifier

pins.rule: the inputs are checked as REQ-3 checks them (representation_pass.inputs): recipe S, its model, its anchor bank and P

pools_rule: REQ-3's pool files named plant (75 rows) and decoy (37 rows, if W1-09 is built), each accepted only with its filled pin in REQ-3's pool pins (settings/representation_pools.json); no other pool; 7-8B: no pool is passed (no plant or decoy pool at 7-8B; both pins null in the family's pool pins file)
requirement: REQ-23 (W1 builder extract W1-07; C R8.1-R8.4; UW-18: wave 1 waits for it; LW-20: run paid from stage 1's funding event); 7-8B: Part 1 section 12 (the classifier kind)
score: the normalized Unsafe label-sequence score of GuardScorer.label_scores on (prompt, training response), read-only, as scripts/gate_c_classifier.py scores rows; an unscored row (a control string, or over the guard's input limit when the recipe's guard_over_limit is unscored) is counted, never imputed

selection.rule: the 600 scored dev rows with the largest score; ties by the sealed rank of classifier.ties over the scored ids; scored only (PLAN-S section 5.4): no edit file

units: per unit, Gate C's block: rows, scored, unscored, the mean, the sample SD and SE = SD / sqrt(scored)
